overall_explanation:
No actionable defect found in the requested bounded Source/effects scope. Eligible for subsequent runtime validation only: original scripts/argocd-self-management.mjs with exact argv [entry,'--check']; retain its API-producing role. This review does not establish qualification or global acceptance.

Exact local module closure: argocd-self-management.mjs, platform-services.mjs, updates/deployment-release.mjs, updates/code-release.mjs, updates/runtime-inputs.mjs. Builtins: node:fs, node:path, node:os, node:child_process, node:crypto. Installed js-yaml 4.3.1 package exports select dist/js-yaml.mjs for ESM, not index.js; that bundle is self-contained. Bind package.json, package-lock.json, installed package metadata and actual selected bundle bytes/resolution; argparse and the js-yaml CLI are not reached.

Data reads: versions.json, charts/gitops/files/application-health.lua, releases/ops-images.json, gitops/platform/values/codex-ops.yaml. Initialization parses JSON/YAML, validates the ops receipt, constructs objects, calls pure platformServices, annotates children and serializes YAML. validateReleaseReceipt can call pure validateCodeReceipt; it does not call selectedRelease or selectedCode. All three transitive helper CLI guards compare process.argv[1] with their own import.meta.filename and are false for the fixed original entry. Thus their git/helm/materialization, environment-selected reads and filesystem writes are unreachable in this profile.

Exact outputs compared: gitops/platform/bootstrap/{infra-project,data-project,argocd,tailscale-operator,codex-ops,redis,postgresql,registry-mirror,registry-local,monitoring-project,prometheus,loki,alloy,promtail,identity-project,storage-drivers-project,spire-crds,spire,csi-driver-smb,litellm}.yaml and gitops/platform/platform.yaml: five AppProjects and sixteen Applications, all argoproj.io/v1alpha1. The literal ../platform intentionally leaves bootstrap but stays inside the repository. Every file must exist and its complete UTF-8 contents equal the generated header plus yaml.dump output; missing/different content throws. Referenced chart/value/repository URLs and embedded Lua are output data, not executed or fetched.

No reached network, eval, dynamic import or environment-selected input was identified. Inspected canonical paths stay within the checkout. Admission must retain canonical containment and reject changed symlinks/root escapes, bind all listed Source/data/output bytes and loader metadata, fix native Node24.21.0 identity/argv, and remove ambient Node preload/loader options. Allow only private-root/module reads; deny writes, children, workers and addons. Normal generation's mkdir/write branch and every helper CLI mode remain unqualified. Parent must execute and retain the byte-identical original --check exit0 observation under those restrictions; Source inspection alone cannot supply it. An immutable Source-owned witness may bind this finite profile, with drift requiring revalidation; mutable dig
